title: Member Service Policy: Security Deposits Records per Assessment and Open Assessments per Basis
content:
## Policy

1. **One record per assessment.** Under Security Deposits a member holds one deposit record for each assessment. A member with several service accounts may therefore hold several deposit records, and one service account may hold both an original deposit and an additional deposit assessed on usage growth. This policy sets no limit on the number of deposit records one member may hold.
2. **One open assessment per basis.** A service account never carries two open assessments on the same assessment basis. A new assessment on a basis that already has a deposit record in assessed or partially paid status on the same service account is not made; the open one is collected instead.

## Basis of the judgement

- The test is made on the cooperative's own deposit records before the assessment is booked; a member's account of what is owed does not replace them.
- Two records are the same object for this test only when they share both the service account and the assessment basis. A deposit record on another service account of the member, or on another basis of the same account, does not engage clause 2.
- An open assessment for this clause is a record in assessed or partially paid status.

## Clause 2 at a glance

| Existing record on the same service account | Same assessment basis | Status of the existing record | Result under clause 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | assessed | the new assessment is not made; the open one is collected |
| yes | yes | partially paid | the new assessment is not made; the open one is collected |
| yes | no | assessed or partially paid | clause 2 does not bar it |
| no (the record is on another account) | yes | assessed or partially paid | clause 2 does not bar it |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Schedule FH member's farm home carries an original Farm Service Deposit in held status; an additional deposit on usage growth on the same account is a separate record on a different basis, and clause 2 does not bar it.
- A General Service Deposit on a shop meter stands in assessed status on the new service basis; a second new service assessment on that meter is not made, and the assessed one is collected.
